name: bluestaq-foundations
description: Portable, App Store ready engineering baseline for Bluestaq code projects. Covers both archetypes (single-file/static and server-backed container): a cold-start runbook, twenty-nine per-domain skills, five front-door commands (/flight-plan, /scaffold, /retro, /readiness, /learn), three fail-closed verification gates, an advisory design critic, the Bluestaq house voice, and three guardrail hooks. Drop into a project's .claude/ to inherit the standards. Use whenever bootstrapping a new repository, hardening an existing one, or preparing a Bluestaq App Store submission.
author: Bluestaq Limited
